description: Contract risk checks for a token on Base, Ethereum or Arbitrum from GoPlus Security: honeypot (can't sell), buy and sell tax, mintable, owner privileges (hidden owner, reclaimable ownership, balance changes, pausable transfers, blacklist, changeable tax), proxy and open-source status, top-holder concentration and liquidity, with a plain-English risk level and the findings behind it. The EVM counterpart of token_security. Automated checks can't prove a token is safe. Fails (and is not charged) if GoPlus has no data or doesn't answer. Costs $0.005 USDC per call.
name: evm_token_security
title: EVM token security check
